description: Relocation of refuse and cycle stores
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (284-004-A-020-B; Received 21/01/2019; 284-004-019-B; Received 07/02/2019; Photos; Received 11/02/2019; Refuse storage details and elevations; Received 12/03/2019.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The hereby approved cycle parking arrangements for the site shall be implemented within 3 month of this decision and shall thereafter be retained as such.
Condition : 4 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements hereby approved shall be implemented within 3 months of decision and shall thereafter be retained as such.
